claim_en: The Reserve Bank explainer states that banks may make up to 25% of new owner-occupier loans at an LVR above 80%.
quote: Up to 25% of new loans can have an LVR above 80%
source_title: Understanding loan-to-value restrictions - Reserve Bank of New Zealand
next_step_en: Ask your lender how it applies the low-deposit lending limit and what extra costs apply.

claim_en: The Reserve Bank explainer states that banks may lend up to 20% of owner-occupier lending to borrowers with a DTI ratio greater than 6.
quote: 20% of owner-occupier lending to borrowers with a DTI ratio greater than 6
source_title: Understanding debt-to-income (DTI) restrictions - Reserve Bank of New Zealand
next_step_en: Ask your lender how it calculates your debt-to-income ratio.

claim_en: Kāinga Ora states the First Home Loan insurance premium is 1.2% of the loan value and, from 1 July 2025, the Government no longer funds part of it; it can be paid upfront or across the loan.
quote: the Government will not provide funding to cover part of the insurance premium
source_title: First Home Loan - Insurance Premium Changes FAQs (22 May 2025) - Kāinga Ora
next_step_en: Ask your lender how the First Home Loan premium would apply to your loan amount.
